content:
We have adsorption_sites.json with categories. Need to choose one adsorption site, preferably an ontop site. Save coordinates to a file (JSON) and output path.

We can select first ontop site coordinates: [1.55967192559206e-05, 2.808257250549678, 14.49482967407359].

Create JSON file with maybe structure {"site_type":"ontop","coordinates":[...]}.

Use write_file.
